fields.description: Tier gate 1. When on, URY reconciles order reservations at sync_order and availability subtracts reservations. No stock-ledger change of any kind. Prerequisite for the other two gates.
fields.label: Reservation Control Enabled

fields.description: Tier gate 2. When on, a KOT item reaching READY creates a fulfilment posting intent and a Manufacture Stock Entry for made-to-order items. Requires Reservation Control Enabled.
fields.label: Realtime Production Posting Enabled

fields.description: Tier gate 3. When on, POS Closing Entry blocks on unposted production and unclosed reservations. Requires Realtime Production Posting Enabled.
fields.label: Closing Reconciliation Enabled
Warning
fields.options: These gates are strictly ordered: closing reconciliation requires real-time production posting, which requires reservation control. Only four states are legal: all off (Tier 1, pure native), reservations only, + production posting (Tier 2 advisory), + closing reconciliation (Tier 2 enforcing). Enabling any gate is a deliberate, auditable, out-of-band admin action -- no code path in this app sets these values. See ARCHITECTURE_POS_STOCK_AUTHORITY.md §3.4.

fields.description: Set automatically the moment any gate transitions from off to on.
fields.label: Enabled By

fields.description: Set automatically the moment any gate transitions from off to on.
fields.label: Enabled On
